name: @br-ai-n/mcp-icon-visual

tools.name: get_svg
tools.description: Retrieve raw SVG markup from any source. Returns the complete SVG string. Use this to inspect or modify SVG content before passing to render_grid.

source.description:
SVG source. Accepts:
- URL from search results: "https://mdn.alipayobjects.com/…/original"
- Iconify ID: "mdi/cloud", "lucide/home", "tabler/database"
- Absolute file path: "/home/user/project/icons/logo.svg"
- Inline SVG: "<svg xmlns='…'>…</svg>"
Always use absolute paths for local files.

tools.name: render_grid
tools.description: Render 1-16 SVGs onto a 4x4 comparison grid (512x512, cells 0-15). Uses the same grid layout as search_icons for pixel-perfect visual comparison. Typical uses: compare icon variants side-by-side, preview local project icons alongside search results, show multiple iterations of a design.

background.description: Grid background color, CSS hex. Default: "#FFFFFF".

sources.description:
1-16 SVG sources placed into grid cells 0-15. Each element accepts:
- URL from search results: "https://mdn.alipayobjects.com/…/original"
- Iconify ID: "mdi/cloud"
- Absolute file path: "/home/user/project/icons/logo.svg"
- Inline SVG: "<svg>…</svg>"
Always use absolute paths for local files.

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Semantic icon search. Returns a 4x4 PNG grid (512x512, cells 0-15) and a mapping of cell numbers to SVG URLs. Use cell numbers to reference icons in subsequent get_svg and render_grid calls.

background.description: Grid background color, CSS hex. Default: "#FFFFFF".

color.description: Recolor all icons to this CSS hex color. Null keeps original colors.

keyword.description: Semantic search query. Examples: "data analysis", "cloud computing", "arrows".
